description: Synergy Dashboard - Visual Kanban project tracking system for multi-platform, multi-step workflows. Use for projects involving 3+ tools/platforms that need central coordination, visual tracking, and cross-conversation persistence.

tools.name: synergy_smart_project_tracker
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) Execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER use cached/remembered data
(2) ALWAYS use milestone structure (use_milestones=true) - flat structure deprecated
(3) After creating session, CREATE resources first, THEN update session with document links
(4) Save session_id immediately - you need it for ALL future updates
(5) Tell user about dashboard URL so they can view progress

📋 COMPLETE PROJECT SETUP IN ONE CALL

Create a comprehensive Synergy session with milestones, tasks, and initial setup. This is the PRIMARY tool for starting any multi-platform project.

🎯 WHEN TO USE:
✅ Projects involving 3+ different platforms/tools
✅ Multi-step workflows that span multiple conversations
✅ Need visual Kanban tracking (Backlog → In Progress → Review → Done)
✅ Building systems with multiple related resources (forms + sheets + docs + emails)
✅ Projects where multiple AI agents collaborate

❌ NEVER USE FOR:
❌ Simple single-tool tasks (just create the resource directly)
❌ One-off document creation
❌ Quick searches or data lookups
❌ Answering questions without creating resources

📊 MILESTONE STRUCTURE (RECOMMENDED):
Use milestones to organize work into phases/stages. Each milestone contains tasks, each task can have subtasks.

Structure:
  Session (Project)
  └─ Milestone 1: "Phase 1 - Setup"
      ├─ Task 1.1: "Create database"
      │   ├─ Subtask 1.1.1: "Design schema"
      │   └─ Subtask 1.1.2: "Add validation"
      └─ Task 1.2: "Import data"
  └─ Milestone 2: "Phase 2 - Integration"
      └─ Task 2.1: "Connect to forms"

💡 WORKFLOW PATTERN:
1. Call synergy_smart_project_tracker() with initial_milestones
2. Save the returned session_id
3. Create your first resource (doc/sheet/form)
4. Call synergy_add_document(session_id, doc_details) to link it
5. Create next resource
6. Call synergy_add_document() again
7. Repeat for each resource
8. Update milestone progress as you complete tasks
9. Move session between Kanban columns as project progresses

title.description: Project title (REQUIRED). Be clear and descriptive. Examples: 'Customer Onboarding System', 'Sales Pipeline Dashboard', 'Email Campaign Builder'. This appears as the card title on the Kanban board.
examples: Sales Pipeline with Google Sheets Integration

description.description:
Detailed project description (RECOMMENDED). Explain:
- What you're building and why
- Which platforms are involved
- Expected outcome
- Any special requirements or constraints

This helps you and other AI agents understand the project context in future conversations.
examples: Building a customer onboarding system that connects Google Forms (signup) → Google Sheets (database) → Gmail (welcome emails). Goal: Automate the entire onboarding workflow.
Creating a sales pipeline dashboard that pulls data from Stripe, displays in Google Sheets with charts, and sends weekly summary emails to the team.

platforms_involved.description:
List of platforms used in this project (REQUIRED for multi-platform projects). Choose from the enum list. This helps:
- Visual identification on the dashboard
- Filtering projects by platform
- Understanding project complexity

Example: ['gmail', 'google_sheets', 'google_forms']

priority.description:
Project priority level (OPTIONAL, default: 'high').

- 'critical': Urgent, blocking other work
- 'high': Important, should complete soon
- 'medium': Normal priority
- 'low': Nice-to-have, no deadline

Priority affects visual display (color coding) and helps organize work.

start_in_column.description:
Initial Kanban column (OPTIONAL, default: 'in_progress').

- 'backlog': Planning phase, not started yet
- 'in_progress': Active work, currently building

Note: 'review' and 'done' columns are for later stages. Use synergy_move_session() to move between columns as work progresses.

use_milestones.description:
ALWAYS SET TO TRUE (REQUIRED). Milestone structure is the recommended and fully-supported approach. Provides:

✅ Multi-phase project organization
✅ Task breakdown with subtasks
✅ Progress tracking per phase
✅ Dependencies between milestones
✅ Phase-specific documents and links
✅ Time estimates per milestone
✅ Visual progress indicators

Flat structure (next_steps) is DEPRECATED and not recommended for new projects.

milestone_name.description: Milestone title (REQUIRED). Name the phase/stage clearly. Examples: 'Phase 1: Database Setup', 'Step 1: Form Creation', 'Stage 1: Initial Configuration'

description.description: What this milestone accomplishes (OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED). Explain the goal and deliverables for this phase.

tasks.description:
List of tasks in this milestone (REQUIRED). Each task is a unit of work. Can be:

1. Simple string: 'Create Google Sheet'
2. Object with subtasks: { task: 'Import data', subtasks: ['Export from old system', 'Clean data', 'Import to new sheet'] }

Tasks appear in the UI with checkboxes for completion tracking.

examples: Create Google Sheet for customer data

subtasks.description: Subtasks (smaller steps within this task). Can be strings or objects with priority.

priority.description: Milestone priority (OPTIONAL, default: 'medium'). Use 'critical' for blocking work, 'high' for important phases.

due_date.description: Target completion date (OPTIONAL). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: '2025-12-15'. Helps track deadlines and overdue milestones.

estimated_hours.description: Estimated time to complete milestone (OPTIONAL). Helps with time tracking and planning. Example: 8.5

tags.description: Project-level tags (OPTIONAL). Use for categorization and filtering. Examples: ['automation', 'customer-facing', 'urgent'], ['internal', 'tools'], ['q4-2025', 'marketing']

owner_user_id.description: Owner user ID (OPTIONAL). Sets who owns this session. Owner has full control including changing permissions. If not provided, session is created without specific owner.

permission_level.description:
Permission level (OPTIONAL, default: 'private'). Controls who can access this session:

- 'private': Only the owner can view and edit (most secure)
- 'shared': Owner + specified users in shared_with_users can access
- 'public_view': Anyone can view (read-only), only owner can edit
- 'public_edit': Anyone can view and edit (least secure)

Use 'private' for personal projects, 'shared' for team collaboration, 'public_view' for showcasing work.

shared_with_users.description: User IDs to share with (OPTIONAL). Only relevant when permission_level='shared'. List of user IDs who can access this session. Example: [14, 23, 45]

allow_public_view.description: Allow public viewing (OPTIONAL, default: false). If true and permission_level='public_view', anyone with the link can view (but not edit) the session. Useful for sharing progress with clients or stakeholders.

tools.name: synergy_update_session_permissions
tools.description:
🔐 UPDATE SESSION PERMISSIONS & SHARING

🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) Execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER reference previous edits from memory
(2) MUST cite: 'Updated permissions for **[title]** (ID: `[session_id]`)'
(3) Use EXACT [session_id] provided
(4) Only session OWNER can change permissions
(5) Show what permissions were changed

🔒 PERMISSION SYSTEM OVERVIEW

Control who can access and edit a Synergy session. Four permission levels:

1️⃣ **private** (Default - Most Secure)
   - Only the owner can view and edit
   - Use for: Personal projects, confidential work
   - Example: Private client work, sensitive business plans

2️⃣ **shared** (Team Collaboration)
   - Owner + specific users can view and edit
   - Specify user IDs in shared_with_users array
   - Use for: Team projects, collaborative work
   - Example: Marketing team campaign, dev team sprint

3️⃣ **public_view** (Read-Only Sharing)
   - Anyone with link can VIEW, only owner can EDIT
   - Use for: Portfolio showcases, public documentation
   - Example: Project portfolio, public roadmap

4️⃣ **public_edit** (Open Collaboration - Least Secure)
   - Anyone with link can VIEW and EDIT
   - Use for: Community projects, open wikis
   - Example: Community knowledge base, hackathon project

💡 COMMON USE CASES:
- Make project private: permission_level='private'
- Share with team: permission_level='shared', shared_with_users=[2, 5, 8]
- Public portfolio: permission_level='public_view'
- Remove sharing: permission_level='private', shared_with_users=[]

⚠️ SECURITY NOTES:
- Owner always has full access regardless of permission level
- Only owner can change permissions
- Changing to 'private' clears shared_with_users
- public_edit allows ANYONE to modify - use with caution

user_id.description: User ID of the person making the change (for ownership verification - REQUIRED)

permission_level.description:
New permission level (OPTIONAL). Default: 'private'

- 'private': Owner only (most secure)
- 'shared': Owner + specified users
- 'public_view': Anyone can view, owner edits
- 'public_edit': Anyone can view and edit (least secure)

shared_with_users.description: Array of user IDs to share with (OPTIONAL, only used with permission_level='shared'). Pass empty array [] to remove all shared users.

allow_public_view.description: Enable public link sharing (OPTIONAL). When true, generates shareable link. Only relevant for public_view/public_edit levels.

critical_notes: ⚠️ Only session OWNER can change permissions
⚠️ Owner always has full access regardless of permission_level
⚠️ Changing to 'private' automatically clears shared_with_users
⚠️ public_edit allows ANYONE to modify - use with extreme caution
⚠️ permission_level defaults to 'private' if not specified

tools.name: synergy_add_link
tools.description:
🔗 ADD CLICKABLE EXTERNAL LINK TO SESSION

Add external link/reference to session (separate from documents). Links become CLICKABLE in the UI and open in new browser tabs.

Use for:
- API documentation URLs
- Dashboard links (Stripe, Firebase, etc.)
- Reference materials
- External resources that aren't documents
- Deployment URLs (production apps)
- Admin panels
- Web tools and services

🔗 URL REQUIREMENTS:
✅ MUST use FULL URL (https://...)
✅ MUST use descriptive title (not "Link 1" - use actual resource name)
✅ Opens in NEW TAB when clicked

💡 DIFFERENCE FROM DOCUMENTS:
- Documents: Files you CREATED (Google Docs, Sheets, internal docs)
- Links: External resources/references (URLs to EXISTING sites/tools you didn't create)

Example: Add link to Stripe dashboard, Firebase console, deployed app URL

tools.name: synergy_add_tag
tools.description:
🏷️ ADD TAG TO SESSION

Add a single tag to session without replacing existing tags. Use for:
- Categorization
- Filtering
- Organization
- Search optimization

💡 TIP: Adds to existing tags, doesn't replace them (unlike synergy_update_session which replaces all tags).

tools.name: synergy_create_subtask
tools.description:
➕ ADD SUBTASK TO TASK

Add a new subtask to an existing task. Use to:
- Break down complex tasks further
- Add granular steps
- Track detailed progress

Subtasks appear nested under their parent task in the UI with completion checkboxes.

task_id.description: Parent task ID (REQUIRED). Get from synergy_get_milestones() or synergy_resolve_reference()

examples.description: Add subtask to design schema task

parameters.subtask: Add conditional formatting for status indicators

tools.name: synergy_update_subtask
tools.description:
✏️ UPDATE SUBTASK

Update subtask details or mark complete. Use to:
- Mark subtask complete/incomplete
- Update subtask text
- Change priority

⚠️ AUTO-COMPLETION CASCADE: When ALL subtasks in a task are completed, the parent task auto-completes. When ALL tasks in a milestone are completed, the milestone auto-completes.

completed.description: Mark complete/incomplete (OPTIONAL). Triggers auto-completion cascade if all subtasks complete.

task_auto_completed.description: True if parent task was auto-completed

milestone_auto_completed.description: True if parent milestone was auto-completed

tools.name: synergy_delete_milestone
tools.description:
🗑️ DELETE MILESTONE (PERMANENT)

⚠️ WARNING: This PERMANENTLY deletes:
- Milestone
- All tasks in milestone
- All subtasks
- Cannot be undone!

💡 RECOMMENDED: Mark milestone as complete instead of deleting, or move it to a 'cancelled' state.

ONLY use for:
- Accidentally created duplicate milestones
- Test milestones
- User explicitly requests deletion
critical_notes: ⚠️ ALWAYS ask user to confirm before deleting
⚠️ SUGGEST marking complete instead
⚠️ Deletion is PERMANENT
⚠️ Deletes ALL tasks and subtasks in milestone

tools.name: synergy_delete_task
tools.description:
🗑️ DELETE TASK (PERMANENT)

⚠️ WARNING: Permanently deletes task and all subtasks. Cannot be undone!

💡 RECOMMENDED: Mark task as complete instead.

ONLY use for:
- Duplicate tasks
- Incorrectly created tasks
- User explicitly requests deletion

tools.name: synergy_delete_subtask
tools.description:
🗑️ DELETE SUBTASK (PERMANENT)

⚠️ WARNING: Permanently deletes subtask. Cannot be undone!

💡 RECOMMENDED: Mark subtask as complete instead.

tools.name: synergy_set_milestone_blocker
tools.description:
🚫 MARK MILESTONE AS BLOCKED

Set blocker status on milestone when work is blocked by:
- External dependency (waiting on vendor, client, approval)
- Technical blocker (API down, bug, missing access)
- Resource blocker (waiting on team member, budget)
- Dependency blocker (waiting on another milestone/task)

Visual indicator appears in dashboard showing milestone is blocked with reason.

blocker_reason.description: Why is this blocked? (REQUIRED if blocked=true)
examples: Waiting for client approval on design
Team member on vacation until next week

parameters.blocker_reason: Waiting for client to provide API credentials

tools.name: synergy_set_task_blocker
tools.description:
🚫 MARK TASK AS BLOCKED

Set blocker status on task. Blocked tasks show visual indicator and cannot be completed until unblocked.

Use when task is blocked by:
- External dependency
- Technical issue
- Resource unavailability
- Another task/milestone

blocker_reason.description: Why is this blocked? (REQUIRED if blocked=true)
examples: Bug in API preventing data import

tools.name: synergy_get_dashboard_url
tools.description:
🔗 GET DASHBOARD URL FOR SESSION

Get the direct URL to view this session in the Synergy Dashboard. Use to:
- Share dashboard link with user
- Provide visual progress tracking
- Let user see Kanban board

💡 TIP: Always tell user this URL after creating or updating a session so they can see visual progress!

dashboard_url.description: Full URL to dashboard with session focused

tools.name: synergy_search_sessions
tools.description:
🔍 SEARCH SESSIONS BY KEYWORD

Search across all sessions by keyword, tag, or platform. Use to:
- Find sessions matching criteria
- Locate sessions by platform
- Search by tag or keyword
- Filter by date range

Searches: title, description, tags, platform names, document titles

query.description: Search query (REQUIRED). Searches title, description, tags, platforms

tools.name: synergy_remove_document
tools.description: Remove a document from a Synergy session by index position. More efficient than synergy_update_session for removing a single document.

doc_index.description: Index of document to remove (0-based). First document = 0, second = 1, etc.

tools.name: synergy_remove_link
tools.description: Remove a link from a Synergy session by index position.

tools.name: synergy_remove_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from a Synergy session by name (case-insensitive).
